title: Wilson–Davis meeting outside EG&G Las Vegas
place_text: EG&G special projects headquarters, Las Vegas

tellings.quote: A year after that, an infamous meeting would take place between scientist Eric Davis and Admiral Thomas Wilson, who oversaw basically all American military technology at the time.

plain: A scientist named Eric Davis and a Navy admiral named Thomas Wilson are said to have held a now infamous meeting outside the Las Vegas special projects headquarters of EG&G, a defense contractor, sometime around 1997 to 2002. Michels says Wilson oversaw "basically all American military technology at the time." Michels tells it himself in passing, without naming a source or saying what was discussed, as one step in the story of secret programs said to hold unexplained craft.
